capabilities: Create character sheets through a creation wizard
Render interactive sheet widgets for health, abilities, skills, spells, and inventory
Manage leveling, equipment, feats, and spellcasting
Support homebrew rules via custom JSON rulebooks
Provide DM tools for sessions and campaigns
extras: Not a replacement for the DnD Player's Handbook; players are expected to self-police rule choices. Includes Critical Role's 'Desperate Measures' mechanic and supports homebrew rulebooks via JSON files. Single-maintainer project with GitHub issue and feature requests.
intentEvidence: I would have never gone through the trouble of making my own plugin to expand upon it.
motivation: The author wanted a comfortable DnD character sheet in Obsidian without hassle.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, manage, and view an interactive DnD 5.5e character sheet inside notes.

relations.evidence: was the inspiration for the color pallete and the reason I started this project

summary: DnD 5.5e (2024) character sheet plugin that renders interactive character sheets inside notes and adds DM tools for sessions and campaigns.
